sloka: तुल्य आसीन्नृपस्तस्य प्रभावाद्वसुरेतसः ।अर्जुनो नाम यत्राग्निः शरकुण्डेशयः सदा ।। ७.३१.८ ॥
transliteration: tulya āsīnnṛpastasya prabhāvādvasuretasaḥ ।arjuno nāma yatrāgniḥ śarakuṇḍeśayaḥ sadā ।। 7.31.8 ॥

translations.english: Its king, named Arjuna, was equal in might to Vasuretasa (Agni), where Agni always resided, known as Sharakuṇḍeśaya.
